Mattatha, saw Alogent's Unify was shortlisted at the Banking Tech Awards and you launched the NXT platform.

Momentum like that usually surfaces more bank and credit-union accounts than the team can cover before it cools, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alogent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mattatha, quick follow-up for Alogent.

A new platform plus award buzz tends to push the pipeline target up faster than reps can ramp. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alogent needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Mattatha, last bit of proof for Alogent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alogent's reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Mattatha, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Alogent either way.
